<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Authorize a return (open an RMA)"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/returns"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Authorizes returning `quantity` units of one order line. The line must
be **allocated** (order-management's local copy; the SKU of the RMA is
taken from that copy, the request's `sku` is accepted and ignored) and
**manifested** (a work unit `{order_id}-line-{line_no}` in the
fulfillment-execution local copy), and now must be inside the policy's
return window. A refusal is 409 `return-not-authorizable` whose
`detail` starts with the rejection code `ORDER_LINE_NOT_ALLOCATED`,
`LINE_NOT_MANIFESTED`, `RETURN_WINDOW_EXPIRED` or
`QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_POLICY`; the same 409 answers a request made before
any disposition policy is declared. At most ONE open RMA may exist per
(orderId, lineNo) (409 `open-rma-exists`). `quantity` must be in
`[1, policy.maxUnitsPerLine]`; the shipped-quantity check is planned,
not built (ADR 0003). A refusal persists nothing and publishes no
event: only a successful authorization publishes `ReturnAuthorized`
through the outbox. Requires an `Idempotency-Key`; replaying the same
key and body returns the original response.
